main_text.p: quæ nos tamdiu compedivit, catenæ: Ita enim invehitur: Exi de ambulacris nostris: ocyus, inquam, te proripe, fucate, adulterate Mango, cum intolerabili redundantia, cum typho, quo cives meos infatuas, & fumis, & apparatu: Loco cede genuinæ, nudæ, simplicique Rationi. Stupet ad hoc tonitru leno: & correptâ temerè sub axillis cosmetice, discedit titubante passu: quàque gradum incertum facit, dissipat, quæ brachio non satis astrinxerat, crotala, mitras, redimicula, fibulas: Ponè cum scopis, Hoc Satellites descripti Amoris-sapientiæ satelles: & everrit: ne quid nudam Rationem, mox præsto futuramptos. vide supra pag. 39..

page.notes: The right margin note reads "Hoc Satellites descriptos. vide supra pag. 39." as set in small italic type. Left-margin fragments from the facing page are cut off and only partly legible; they were not transcribed. Some words in the note column are uncertain due to small type.
